70592624.title: AGIBOT signs strategic cooperation agreement with Singtel Enterprise
70592624.formatted:
AGIBOT partners with Singtel Enterprise on embodied AI and robotics

• The two firms signed a strategic cooperation agreement, but no financial terms, deal scope, or specific deliverables were disclosed.
70592624.summary: SINGAPORE, March 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AGIBOT, a global leader in embodied artificial intelligence and robotics, today announced the signing of a strategic cooperation agreement with Singtel Enterprise.
